exp.desc:
- Receiving around 30 trucks per shift
- Date and temperature checks
- WMS booking, scanner training

cl.p1: Around thirty trucks arrive in our goods-in area every shift, and I make sure every pallet is booked correctly and put in the right location. I have done this for five years with an error rate I am quite proud of.
cl.p2: I check deliveries against orders, inspect use-by dates and temperatures for chilled goods, book stock on the WMS and resolve discrepancies with purchasing. I drive counterbalance and reach trucks and trained the early shift when we switched to new scanners.
cl.p3: I would like to grow into a team leader role in a larger food warehouse. Rotating shifts are fine.

cl.p1: After six years as a cycle courier I am looking for a permanent job with regular shifts. I know parcels and delivery notes – just from the other end of the chain. Now I want the other end.
cl.p2: I am fit, quick and accurate: I delivered up to 80 items a day using a scanner and app. I passed my forklift course this summer and would like to build experience with you.
cl.p3: I can work early and late shifts and can start immediately.
